_about: GU Hyper (rEmDouMouKaData; dev/hyper-states.md): per monster the aura table of each of its two .mdd files -- `normal` (<id>_doumouka.mdd, loaded below G rank) and `g` (<id>_doumouka_g.mdd, loaded at G rank: e+0xb736 = quest rank > 4, 0x6f1c0..0x6f1d8; the loader 0x4bd64 takes resource column 0x26 / 0x27 by it). An aura: DouMouKaID, SpecificPartsGroup (0 / 1: one aura per group at a time), SpecificParts (the part), the u record 1300 + ID (0xca1f8: u id 47 + ID through the base table 0x159c7fc) and its joint; `meat` / `meatBias` its MeatChange_Group slots and MeatChange_SpecificParts_Bias (vt+0x18c 0xca900, read by the deflect classifier 0x16d800). Generated by dev/archive/cen/mkhyperauras.py from hypermdd.py's hyper.json.
